authority: derived cross-classification of already registered historical letter categories; not a Tree-edge assignment, pronunciation canon, musical correspondence, curriculum authority, recognition, identity, governance, MANA policy, or metaphysical ontology
purpose: Represent each of the twenty-two registered letters by the intersection of two independent source-derived categorical axes: Mother/Double/Simple letter class and one of five articulation regions.
derived_observations: The three Mother letters occupy three different articulation regions: Alef=guttural, Shin=dental, Mem=labial; no Mother is registered in the palatal or lingual columns.
No Double letter is registered in the guttural column.
Simple letters occupy all five articulation regions.
The five articulation regions therefore cut across the 3/7/12 letter classes rather than duplicating them.
A letter may be represented as a pair (letter_class, articulation_region) before any individual Tree-edge or musical mapping is selected.

tree_bridge.safe_use: If a future sourced correspondence assigns an individual letter to a Tree edge, its articulation-region metadata can travel with that letter as a second independent coordinate.
tree_bridge.unsafe_use: Choosing a Tree edge merely because its synthetic timbre sounds compatible with an articulation region.

vitae_boundary.posture: The matrix is letter metadata, not a curriculum prerequisite or recognition structure.

candidate_laws: Two Coordinates Before One Correspondence — preserve class and articulation as independent letter metadata before selecting any individual Tree path.
Cross-Cutting Axes Are Stronger Than Count Matches — an independently sourced intersection is more informative than two unrelated sets sharing a cardinality.
Articulation Travels With the Letter, Not With the Tree Edge — only a sourced letter assignment may carry articulation metadata onto a specific path.
Sparse Matrix Is Not Missing Meaning — empty category intersections do not require invented letters, elements, or paths.
not_encoded: a canonical historical Tree correspondence scheme
recognition, readiness, Identity, authority, governance, or MANA effects
